cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Watch how I win this raffle. I taught you probability; buy my ticket just before the draw, so it lands on top.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just buy a ticket. They all go in the drum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remembered the sample space. A late ticket will still be nearest the hand, so we'll wait.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They spin the drum before picking one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then buy now, before the queue gets long. We want every chance to reach the centre; that's the position I was waiting for you to consider. One ticket, please.

reason: Connect the specific tuition to A present pursuit. Make B correction or practical objection change A actual demand, and replace detached final explanations with an action or answer A needs.
